note: Machine-readable write scopes for project-level agent configuration and plugins. Humans and harnesses should treat denyWrite as authoritative. The documentation gate is also enforced at commit time by .githooks/pre-commit and tools/check_docs_policy.cjs.

docs-writer.description: Sole writer of the documentation library docs/**.

implementation-agent.description: Implements source, resources and tooling; must never write docs/**.

lead.description: Triages documentation proposals, dispatches the docs-writer, reviews deliveries.
